scenarios.scenario: Retain panel visibility while switching tabs and parts

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the first part is active with the 3D Model ribbon expanded
the Parameters panel is visible
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon tab
the Parameters panel is still visible
the user activates the second part document
its 3D Model ribbon also shows the Parameters panel
the user returns to the first part document
its Parameters panel remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Home and End leave the focused panel row unchanged

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full top-docked 3D Model ribbon is visible
the direct panel selector is open with Create focused and checked
the user presses Home
Create remains focused and checked
the panel selector remains open
the user presses End
Create remains focused and checked
the panel selector remains open
the user presses Escape
the panel selector closes

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore a panel while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the full Sketch ribbon displays the Pattern panel and the Finish action
the user right-clicks the Sketch tab
the user opens Show Panels
Pattern is checked in the panel list
the user selects Pattern
the menus close and the Pattern panel disappears from the ribbon
the remaining ribbon panels reflow and Finish remains visible
the user reopens Show Panels from the Sketch tab context menu
Pattern is unchecked
the user selects Pattern
the Pattern panel returns to the Sketch ribbon
Finish remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Preserve Tools panel choices while switching to Home

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and the Home workspace is available in the MCAD Software
the part is active with the full Tools ribbon visible
the Tools panel selector is open
Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find and Team Web are checked
Tutorials is unchecked
the user selects the Home workspace tab
Home is displayed and the part panel selector is no longer visible
the user returns to the part document tab
the Tools ribbon is visible and the panel selector is closed
the user opens the Tools panel selector
Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find and Team Web are checked
Tutorials is unchecked
the user presses Escape
the panel selector closes
the part and Tools ribbon remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Right-click a solid face while the panel selector is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a visible solid in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon and its panel selector are open
the user right-clicks a visible solid face outside the selector
the panel selector closes
the Tools ribbon and part remain visible
no face context menu is visible in the captured state
a small face-selection control appears near the pointer

scenarios.scenario: Show and hides the Layout panel during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the Sketch tab is active
the Layout panel is hidden
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
Layout is unchecked in the panel list
the user selects Layout
the Layout panel appears between Constrain and Insert
Make Part and Make Components are disabled
Create Block is enabled
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
the user selects Layout
the Layout panel is hidden again
the other visible Sketch panels remain in place
the sketch remains in edit mode

scenarios.scenario: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the Sketch tab is active
the Parameters panel is hidden
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
Parameters is unchecked in the panel list
the user selects Parameters
the Parameters panel appears after Format and before Exit
the panel displays a large parameter symbol
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
the user selects Parameters
the Parameters panel is hidden again
the sketch remains in edit mode
